sloka: त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् विवेष्टन्तो रामिप्रियचिकीर्षवः।यन्निमित्तं हि युद्ध्यामो हता सा जनकात्मजा ।। ६.८२.२२ ।।
transliteration: tyaktvā prāṇān viveṣṭanto rāmipriyacikīrṣavaḥ।yannimittaṁ hi yuddhyāmo hatā sā janakātmajā ।। 6.82.22 ।।

translations.english: "On telling this fact (that Indrajith has killed Sita) to Rama and Sugriva and knowing their reply we will do what is to be done."
